# Config: Apps

> **Reader:** `Apps` (`config/Apps.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Apps` · category General · scope personal

Apps: The apps axiom opens: by the Terminal, File manager and Browser keybinds, and the launcher's terminal apps and Shift+Enter commands.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `Apps`

- **`Apps.terminal`** · string = "kitty"
  - Terminal: Terminal used for commands run with Shift+Enter, for terminal apps and by the Terminal keybind. It's started as: terminal -e command.
  - x-scope="commands"
  - read: `Apps.terminal` · in: `components/surfaces/onboarding/pages/AppsPage.qml`, `services/ui/LauncherManager.qml`
- **`Apps.fileManager`** · string = ""
  - File manager: Command the File manager keybind runs. Empty opens your home folder in the system's default file manager.
  - x-scope="commands"
  - read: `Apps.fileManager` · in: `components/surfaces/onboarding/pages/AppsPage.qml`
- **`Apps.browser`** · string = ""
  - Browser: Command the Browser keybind runs. Empty starts the system's default web browser.
  - x-scope="commands"
  - read: `Apps.browser` · in: `components/surfaces/onboarding/pages/AppsPage.qml`
- **`Apps.pinned`** · array<string> = []
  - Pinned apps: Desktop entry ids, in order: the apps every dock shows first, unless it has its own (Dock → pinnedOwn).
  - x-scope="personal", x-settings=false
  - read: `Apps.pinned` (computed) · in: `components/views/Settings/DockListCard.qml`, `config/DockConfig.qml`, `services/ui/DockManager.qml`
